clients.name: Electronic Patient Record API
clients.description: The resource server. Access tokens must carry this client id in `aud`.

clients.name: Electronic Patient Record UI
clients.description: The browser UI (authorization code flow with PKCE), used by the UI's backend-for-frontend sign-in (SE-9). Port 4310 is the end-to-end test port.

clients.name: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: password grant for scripts and tests
clients.description: Lets scripts/keycloak-dev-token.sh obtain a token without a browser. Never import this client into a real deployment.
